evidence: Amina Restaurant is a restaurant and bar in No Libs Philadelphia, serving up American Southern cuisine.
With African-inspired culinary creations, Amina introduces a unique and unparalleled flavor experience to the area.
Amina is a destination for a fun dining experience.
